_note: PLACEHOLDER dates until the real counselling schedule is confirmed. While placeholder is true the site labels them as sample dates. Dates are ISO (YYYY-MM-DD); kind is mcc or state.

events.title: NEET UG result
events.body: Download your scorecard and note your All India Rank.

events.title: MCC Round 1 registration and choice filling opens
events.body: Register, pay the fee and start filling your choice list.

events.title: MCC Round 1 choice locking closes
events.body: Lock your final order before the deadline, or the last saved list is locked for you.

events.title: MCC Round 1 result
events.body: See your allotment and decide whether to report, or join and opt for an upgrade.

events.title: State quota Round 1 registration (most states)
events.body: Each state runs its own schedule. Check your state's counselling portal.

events.title: MCC Round 2 choice filling
events.body: Fresh choices for Round 2. Seats freed in Round 1 come back in.

events.title: MCC Round 3 choice filling
events.body: The last regular round before the stray vacancy round.

events.title: MCC stray vacancy round
events.body: Leftover seats are filled. Keep your documents ready.
